name: Naratyn
source:
Naratyn – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Naratyn is a young adorable green-eyed golden om'verai. Naratyne does have 3 yellow eye rings and green spots. Naratyn has 15 neck and nose spikes, spiral head horns and 4 thin cheek spikes.
Naratyn is kind, but hates studying psychonetic. Felt in love with Azaries, loves sweets and enjoys eating ice-cream at cafe. Later becomes more confident and aggressive.
